scientific_integrity: Full versus true polyanalytic kernels are distinguished; the modular argument is exact and exhaustive after a proved algebraic-field reduction; this is a same-model assessment, not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Full order-four space in one complex dimension, exact pairwise point-evaluation orthogonality; no true-level, near-orthogonal, simultaneous perturbation, or higher-dimensional statement. Historical priority is best-knowledge.
title: Three, not four: a modular obstruction for orthogonal fourth-order polyanalytic Fock evaluations
